items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered a sprained MCL vs Titans and is likely to miss a few weeks.
items.why: Sprained MCL confirmed by tests, per Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Eagles TE production takes hit; monitor backups for targets/snaps.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow and will consult specialists; Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle Week 3.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (recurrence); no fracture on X-ray but further eval; team protocol.
items.implication: Mariota starts; WAS offense efficiency drop; monitor McLaurin/Samuel/Deebo targets.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream; WR/TE volume may rise in volume but efficiency fall

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is week-to-week with hamstring injury after MRI; expects to miss some time. Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; MRI done; coach confirms miss time.
items.implication: Bagent likely starts Week 3 vs PHI; CHI pass game downgrade short-term.
items.opportunity: Bagent streaming/handcuff value; Swift/Odunze/Loveland volume stable or up

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.implication: McConkey plays (with docks possible); Harvey out opens Coleman.

items.text: Falcons named Michael Penix Jr. starting QB for Thursday vs Packers; ACL ready after splitting reps.
items.implication: ATL offense shift; potential boost to London/Bijan if more efficient.
items.opportunity: Red zone/drive success chance up from zero so far

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating treatment and recovery timeframe.
items.why: Back injury; hospital overnight; recovery TBD.
items.implication: GB WR depth tested; Wicks/Watson upside if out.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead back; Gainwell clear handcuff only.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes for Irving

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs explosiveness while Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson docked but still involved.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE after 27% and 38% target shares first two games; leads all WRs in expected PPR points this week per model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead.
items.implication: Must-start WR1; high floor/ceiling in PHI offense.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor; he played through it.
items.why: Stinger; played through; MRI today for confirmation.
items.implication: Likely available but monitor; Gainwell already limited role.
items.opportunity: Confirm active; no major role shift expected

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan does not believe WR Mike Evans’ hip injury was serious; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.why: Hip; coach says not serious, could return if needed.
items.implication: Evans available; Robinson out longer potentially.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jayden Reed (head/back), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), plus Price, Brooks, Dowdle, Jones, Dobbins, Njoku/Kolar etc.
items.why: Postgame compilation of key fantasy injuries from Sunday slate.
items.implication: Priority monitoring for Week 3 status changes and beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Multiple role expansion opportunities if OUT

items.text: Weekend reports: McConkey (rib) GTD optimism/flak jacket; Nacua (hip) GTD; Harvey (ham) not expected; Olave/Burrow expected; Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Pre-game clarity for DFS/season long; beneficiaries for OUTs.
items.opportunity: McConkey/Nacua if active; backups for Flowers/Pittman/Harvey

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a handful of WRs worse.
items.why: Extremely low YPRR data through two weeks.
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite targets; monitor for role or scheme changes.
items.opportunity: Routes still there but poor YPRR signals limited big-play upside currently
